summary: Phase AD.2 Sponsored Games Revenue Split — comprehensive backend + frontend testing. Wrote 13 pytest test cases covering all 13 acceptance criteria: split arithmetic (5¢ → 3¢ merchant / 2¢ platform banker's-rounded), idempotency (duplicate_event on same event_id), daily cap (4th impression same user rejected, different user's cap independent), wallet exhaustion (auto-pause + game_campaign unlink + subsequent not_sponsored), RBAC on both GET endpoints (403 for other users, 200 for owner + admin), admin PATCH commission-rules (upsert to 20/80 then restore to 30/70), non-sponsored game short-circuit. ALL 13 backend tests PASSED. Frontend UI verified via Playwright: /advertiser/dashboard/sponsored-games renders with active sidebar tab, all 4 total testids populated ($0.15 / $0.09 / $0.06), sg-row-{gc_id}-active badge shown, 3 sg-event-* rows rendered. Merchant dashboard shows merchant-game-sponsorship-widget with 30d + lifetime cent totals + 1 sponsor row + 1 game campaign row.
critical_code_review_comments: SUGGESTION: The `stripe_payment_intent_id` field uses namespaced placeholder `ad2_{txn_id}` to bypass the non-sparse unique index — this is documented in-code and mirrors MER.3 pattern; acceptable but consider migrating that legacy index to sparse in a future cleanup.

SUGGESTION: `record_game_event` step 5 passes category='*' to commission_service intentionally (documented) — the fallback design is correct but tightly coupled to the seeded commission rule row. If the seed is ever deleted the split silently reverts to the 10% generic rule. Consider adding a boot-time assertion that the sponsored_game rule exists (seed script already does this idempotently on startup).

OBSERVATION: The event_type discriminator in `_fee_cents_for` returns 0 for CPM+entry or CPC+impression combos → these are silently no-billed with reason='no_billable_combo'. That is correct behavior but the client has no way to distinguish this from a misconfiguration; adding a warn log would help ops.

OBSERVATION: In `list_advertiser_game_transactions` the per-campaign enrichment does N+1 lookups (one game_campaigns + one businesses per row). Not a bug at current scale but flag for future denormalization if advertiser dashboards get slow.
